A fourth test build of the new HOME Menu art, ahead of 0.2.1. The game itself is the same as 0.2.0.

rc.3's 3D banner works on a console. This build only removes its flat grey fog sheet, so the mark, the falling ash and the wordmark sit on the HOME Menu's own background. Nothing else in the banner changed, and it still follows only patterns from the banners known to work.

If the HOME Menu crashes or freezes, hold POWER to switch off, start the console, open FBI without highlighting sh23ds and reinstall rc.3's CIA over it.

- **Icon:** the website's mark, nine rusted red squares on black, in both the CIA and the 3DSX.
- **Name and details:** "Silent Hill 2", "The PC Director's Cut, ported to the 3DS", by "sh23ds by ankushKun".
- **3D banner:** the mark swaying with ash falling and the SILENT HILL 2 wordmark in front, with a short jingle of radio static, two heartbeats and a low chord.
